<p>Updated December 8, 2025|Published December 5, 2024</p>
<p>Welcome, bakers! For 21 years, Washington Post Food has published an annual holiday cookie issue. We’ve cooked up more than 400 tried, true and tested (and tasted!) recipes for whenever you need a sweet treat at this time of year, or any other.</p>
<p>We have assembled all these recipes into our Holiday Cookie Generator. Here you can filter by a wide variety of interests or needs, including ingredients, diet and publication year. Find something you like? Click on the star button to add the recipe to your saved stories.</p>
<p>We have recipes featuring chocolate, spices, fruit and nuts, in the form of drop cookies, bar cookies, no-bake cookies and so much more. We’re confident you’ll find a few new favorites to add to your cookie rotation.</p>
<p>Happy baking!</p>
<p>Showing all 419 cookies</p>
<p>Click thestaricon to save cookie recipes across your devices.</p>
